title: Satisfiability of Equality Equations
goal: Determine whether all equalities and inequalities between variables can hold at once.
strategy: First union every equality so transitive equality is complete. Then reject any inequality whose two variables have the same representative; all other components can receive different values.

edgeCases: Different equality components can satisfy inequalities
A variable cannot differ from itself
Repeated and reflexive equalities are harmless
